locations.name: Hawkes family quarters, Deck Nine
locations.notes: The family home aboard Jupiter Station. Family dinner at the Hawkes quarters is established in the episode (Ch. 20). The Deck Nine placement comes from directive section 21. Exact layout, dimensions, and room count are not established and are marked UNKNOWN below. The directive lists recovered details for these quarters; each is recorded as RECONSTRUCTED, not ESTABLISHED, because the directive does not cite the underlying primary source for each detail.
locations.source_locator: Directive section 21; Compendium Part 5, section 5.6 (family dinner, episode Ch. 20)

locations.name: Ellie's quarters, Jupiter Station

persistence_test.procedure: Place the mug in Ellie's quarters and record its position as a world_state row with history_kind recovered. Noah moves the mug; the move is proposed, validated, executed, and written as an executed_events receipt with actor, witnesses, time, branch, and what changed. Stop every process. Cold restart. Return. The mug is still where it was left. Ask how the mug got here; the system returns the executed event receipt.

provenance_standard: Every rendered object must answer where did you come from. The answer is one of four provenance values: ESTABLISHED (a source establishes it, with a source locator), RECONSTRUCTED (compiled from evidence by FORGE, with a source locator), GENERATED_VISUAL (FORGE or LACUNA generated it so the room can render, with a LACUNA note and no source locator), or UNKNOWN (not established, with the gap stated). A rendered object with no provenance value is not a valid object in this WorldSpec.
